message.content:
Here are some of the major airports in the United States, ranked by passenger traffic and importance as international hubs:

| Airport | City | State | IATA Code | Notable Features |
|---------|------|-------|-----------|------------------|
| Hartsfield‑Jackson Atlanta International Airport (ATL) | Atlanta | Georgia | ATL | Largest airport in the world by passenger traffic; major hub for Delta Air Lines. |
| Los Angeles International Airport (LAX) | Los Angeles | California | LAX | Major gateway to Asia and Latin America; key hub for American Airlines and United. |
| Chicago O’Hare International Airport (ORD) | Chicago | Illinois | ORD | One of the busiest airports in the U.S.; major hub for United and American. |
| Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport (DFW) | Dallas/Fort Worth | Texas | DFW | Large hub for American Airlines; one of the largest airports by land area. |
| Denver International Airport (DEN) | Denver | Colorado | DEN | Known for its distinctive peaked roof; hub for United and Southwest. |
| John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK) | New York City | New York | JFK | Major international gateway; hub for many carriers including JetBlue and Delta. |
| San Francisco International Airport (SFO) | San Francisco | California | SFO | Key hub for United and a major gateway to Asia. |
| Seattle–Tacoma International Airport (SEA) | Seattle | Washington | SEA | Hub for Alaska Airlines and a growing hub for Delta. |
| Miami International Airport (MIA) | Miami | Florida | MIA | Major hub for LATAM and a key gateway to Latin America. |
| Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport (PHX) | Phoenix | Arizona | PHX | Hub for American Airlines; one of the busiest airports in the Southwest. |
| Orlando International Airport (MCO) | Orlando | Florida | MCO | Major hub for Southwest and a key gateway to the Caribbean. |
| Newark Liberty International Airport (EWR) | Newark | New Jersey | EWR | Major hub for United; close proximity to New York City. |
| Charlotte Douglas International Airport (CLT) | Charlotte | North Carolina | CLT | Hub for American Airlines; one of the fastest-growing airports. |
| Detroit Metropolitan Wayne County Airport (DTW) | Detroit | Michigan | DTW | Hub for Delta; one of the largest airports in the Midwest. |

These airports serve as major hubs for domestic and international flights, handling millions of passengers each year and connecting travelers to destinations worldwide.
